source.quote_free_summary: A competitor who does not report to the Floor Coordinator on time, or does not answer the Floor Coordinator's calls for a heat, is disqualified from that dance category. II.G.1.c separately states that failing to enter and dance Two Step brings disqualification in that division.

requirement: A future UCWDC body profile must model the missed-call disqualification (and keep it distinct from Scratch, No-show and organizer Exclusion). Studio/Custom never presents a no-show or exclusion as this rule.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Future: a UCWDC profile floor-check-in rule. No DanceFlow action, status or workflow models it; the existing 'Excluded (organizer decision)' action (CF1 A5) is organizer policy and is never a substitute.
interpretation_notes: Exact short phrase re-read 2026-11-23 (line 'will be disqualified from that dance category'). DanceFlow NS1 no-show: marked by staff, entry excluded from the round, NOT placed last and NOT a disqualification; do not conflate. Whether UCWDC's rule is automatic or needs a ruling is not stated. BLOCKER for a UCWDC profile.
